title: Alibaug
description: Coastal town famed for Kolaba Fort, pristine sandy beaches, and water sports.

title: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad)
description: Historical hub home to UNESCO World Heritage Sites Ajanta and Ellora caves, and Bibi Ka Maqbara.

title: Harihareshwar & Shrivardhan
description: Scenic coastal duo known for the revered Kalbhairav temple, rocky beach cliffs, and tranquil shorelines.

title: Rishikesh
description: Yoga capital of the world located on the Ganges, famous for river rafting, Lakshman Jhula, and evening Aarti.

title: Mussoorie
description: Queen of the Hills offering misty views of the Himalayas, Kempty Falls, and colonial-era Mall Road charm.

title: Bhandardara
description: Serene hill station renowned for Arthur Lake, Wilson Dam, Randha Falls, and monsoon firefly festivals.

title: Matheran
description: Asia's only automobile-free hill station, known for reddish soil trails, toy train rides, and panoramic view points.

title: Ujjain
description: Ancient holy city on the Kshipra River, famous for the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga temple and Kumbh Mela.

title: Omkareshwar
description: Sacred island shaped like the Om symbol in the Narmada River, housing a prominent Jyotirlinga shrine.

title: Mahabaleshwar
description: Western Ghats hill station famous for strawberry farms, Venna Lake, and dramatic cliff-side viewpoints.

title: Nashik
description: Ancient pilgrimage town and wine capital of India, featuring Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga, Panchavati, and lush vineyards.

title: Konkan Coast
description: Stunning coastal belt featuring coconut groves, historic sea forts, Alphonso mangoes, and pristine beaches.
